_comment_registration_runtime: Anatomical ANTs fitting uses centre-of-mass initialization and one ITK thread for repeatability; the rigid EPI-to-EPI bridge keeps header/identity initialization. SyN and fit direction keep their existing settings. New settings require fresh preparation/QC.
_comment_decoder_correlation_qc: QC only: spatial Pearson r within a fixed decoder ROI, after transforms and before smoothing/cGLM/normalization. Supply a decoder-training mean EPI already on the final analysis grid; null uses a labelled session-reference fallback. Optional QC ROI NIfTI on that same grid; useful for genuine feature masks. CSV each TR, PNG and run_qc.xlsx at run completion.
_comment: Minjoo v2: online spatial preparation. Use this same profile for the reference run and subsequent neurofeedback runs.
_comment_json: JSON does not support native comments, so this file uses _comment fields for inline notes.
_comment_timing: TR=1s, final analysis in T1 space. Spatial transforms, cumulative-GLM denoising, optional smoothing and voxel normalization use the current shared pipeline.
_comment_masks: Mask-based nuisance regressors. GS is disabled to avoid over-correcting global signal.
_comment_biopac: BIOPAC/RETROTS defaults. Enable only when physiology input is available.
_comment_runtime: Realtime robustness and performance settings used on the scanner workstation.
_comment_fieldmap: Fieldmap correction settings for realtime unwarping. PyHySCO phase encoding is derived from epi_phase_encoding.
_comment_truncation: Set true only when transforms should be restricted to the EPI field of view.
_comment_resampler: GPU resampling is intended for the CUDA-enabled scanner workstation.
_comment_reference: Use this same settings file for the reference and all later NF runs; existing TR=1/T1-space decoder/BIOPAC disabled settings are retained.
_comment_online_preprocessing: offline_assets is null: use native anatomical/session preparation. Anatomical fitting is T1-to-EPI with Rigid/Affine/SyN, centre-of-mass initialization and one ITK thread; the EPI-to-EPI bridge uses identity initialization.
_comment_voxel_normalization: Each run establishes its own first 30 valid fitted samples for voxel z-scoring and then freezes that reference. This setting is independent of behavioral background timing.
